title: Lofted shell and kernel assembly
summary: An elliptical loft with 1.5 mm inward shell, plus a separate 5 mm box constructed through direct OpenCascade. Dimensions are millimeters.
script:
from OCP.BRepPrimAPI import BRepPrimAPI_MakeBox
from OCP.gp import gp_Pnt

# A smooth elliptical loft, opened and shelled through CadQuery.
body = (cq.Workplane('XY').ellipse(20, 12)
        .workplane(offset=8).ellipse(16, 10).loft()
        .faces('>Z').shell(-1.5))

# A second positioned part created directly with the OpenCascade bindings.
kernel_box = cq.Shape.cast(BRepPrimAPI_MakeBox(gp_Pnt(35, 0, 0), 5, 5, 5).Shape())
result = cq.Assembly().add(body, name='lofted_shell').add(kernel_box, name='kernel_box')
